apparel.name: Moonthread Stud Earrings
apparel.description: Tiny silver studs threaded with pale blue silk from Hedda's midnight loom.
apparel.passive: Within the next hour, you gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Performance) check.

apparel.name: Courtiers Pearl Necklace
apparel.description: A single freshwater pearl on a braided cord favored by discreet nobles.
apparel.passive: When making a Charisma (Persuasion) check at court or a formal gathering, you may roll the check with advantage once.

apparel.name: Fleetfoot Wool Socks
apparel.description: Soft wool socks with reinforced heels for long market days.
apparel.passive: For 10 minutes after donning, your walking speed increases by 5 feet.

apparel.name: Cobblers Road Shoes
apparel.description: Sturdy leather shoes with hobnailed soles for cobbled streets and country paths.
apparel.passive: For 1 hour, difficult terrain composed of rubble, stones, or unpaved roads doesn't cost you extra movement.

apparel.name: Scandal Sleeve Gloves
apparel.description: Fitted gloves in last season's scandalous sleeve pattern—too bold for some parlors.
apparel.passive: Within the next hour, you gain a +2 bonus to your next Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

apparel.name: Whisper-Linen Shawl
apparel.description: Pale linen dyed to fade into festival crowds and evening mist.
apparel.passive: Once before your next long rest, you have advantage on a Dexterity (Stealth) check made in a crowd or busy street.

apparel.name: Loom-Warden Work Apron
apparel.description: Heavy canvas apron with pockets for pins, chalk, and measuring cord.
apparel.passive: Within the next hour, you gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Investigation) check made to examine fabric, clothing, or disguises.

apparel.name: Silk Mask of the Masque
apparel.description: A half-mask of dyed silk tied with satin ribbons for masked balls.
apparel.passive: Within the next hour, you gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Deception) check.

apparel.name: Heddas Lucky Hairpin
apparel.description: A brass hairpin shaped like a weaver's shuttle—Hedda's own good-luck charm.
apparel.passive: When you fail a Charisma saving throw, you can reroll the save and must use the new roll. Once used, the hairpin loses this property until you finish a long rest.

apparel.name: Mourning Black Cloak Pin
apparel.description: A jet cloak pin polished until it drinks the light—popular for secret mourning orders.
apparel.passive: Within the next hour, you gain a +2 bonus to your next Charisma (Intimidation) check.
